acceptance: Legible plaintext (printable_ratio>=0.85 and entropy<=5.9, or an English run of >=6 letters) or a 32-byte window gating to a prize target; padding logged, never accepted.
hypothesis: 'Seven intertwined passwords' names a weave that is not a round-robin braid, and one of these fifteen weaves opens chain1 or chain2 with legible plaintext.
scope_note: Closes fifteen non-round-robin weave functions on two seven-part sets against chain1 and chain2 under EVP MD5 and SHA-256. It does not re-enumerate orderings (v50 did that for round-robin), and it does not test Cosmic, Chain 4, or weaves of stage answers.
why_new: v50 falsified round-robin braid and zip over every ordering. Each weave frozen here is a different function, not a reordering: it keeps fill characters, moves multi-character chunks, nests, reverses parts, stacks letters modularly, transposes a grid, composes Caesar shifts, or alternates head and tail.
